name: Luana Tanaka
bio: Luana Tanaka Ostan (São Paulo, October 11, 1989) is a Brazilian actress.

credits.title: Pecadora
credits.overview: Isabel is a very religious young woman whose life is transformed when she starts working with Enrico, a free-spirited and seductive man. As she tries to deny her attraction to her colleague and the awakening of her most forbidden desires, she finds herself confronting everything she always believed.

credits.title: Cinco Tipos de Medo
credits.overview: Murilo, a grieving musician, falls for Marlene, a nurse trapped in an abusive relationship with criminal Sapinho. Their fates intertwine with Luciana, a vengeful cop, and Ivan, a lawyer with hidden motives, as five lives collide on an irreversible path.

credits.title: Sexa
credits.overview: Bárbara, 60, fed up with society's expectations of aging women, swears off romance to please her son. But when she falls for 35-year-old Davi, she must choose between the role imposed on her or embracing a passionate new love.

credits.title: Undercover Party Crasher
credits.overview: In order to get evidence for her case and dismantle a criminal organization, an uptight undercover cop crashes a high school graduation trip to a party-heavy beach in Brazil.

credits.title: Detetive Madeinusa
credits.overview: A bumbling new detective is hired by a billionaire lobbyist to investigate the theft of a prized ox. To unravel the peculiar case, he forms an unbeatable team with his assistant Uóston, the waitress and psychic Marcela, the detective accessories store clerk Larissa and the hacker Zuleide. credits.title: Oni
credits.overview: In the depths of forgotten memories, a tormented spirit waits patiently.
